$description: fomo Campus recommended house tokens. Core and web colors follow the Campus site; cyan and black are reserved for social campaign compositions. Templates are recommendations for future work, not a claim of prior approval.

blue.$description: Primary Campus brand blue. Logo fills, large display text, and non-text brand accents.

electric.$description: Secondary campaign accent. Use sparingly; do not replace primary Campus blue by default.

highlight.$description: Soft decorative highlight on dark campaign surfaces.

ink.$description: Primary dark campaign canvas and high-contrast text on pale backgrounds.

pale.$description: Pale supporting surface or text on ink.

white.$description: Light canvas and text on approved dark surfaces.

action.$description: Accessible primary button fill for white text.

signal.$description: Exact cyan from the fundraiser story, selected to standardize new social accents; not an exact sampled color from the grid. Use for large headlines or milestone emphasis on black/ink, not as the primary web brand blue.

family.$description: House default. Recent campaign use of Poppins ExtraBold is a campaign exception.

story.description: House safe-area guidance; interface overlays vary. Confirm the final preview in the destination app.
